modifications: Adapt perspective window-depth reconstruction to fragment shader; add orthographic and normalized output.
Use canonical project camera and owned sampleable depth attachment, not TiXL host types.

The original bounded 1..64 golden-angle gather came from TiXL; replace its unsigned depth comparison with Godot circular bokeh's signed near/far CoC and occlusion limit while retaining project depth and premultiplied-alpha contracts.

Port Godot's Circle, Box and Hexagon quality profiles, signed R16F weight buffer, separable shape passes, half-resolution path and final weight composite to bgfx views. The graph writes into a distinct target, so the half-resolution composite explicitly combines original and blurred premultiplied RGB instead of relying on blending over Godot's in-place base buffer.
Retain dof_samples only as a legacy document compatibility input; explicit dof_quality selects the fixed Godot quality profile.
